name: schovi-workflows
description: David Schovanec's personal Claude Code workflow plugins

plugins.name: schovi
plugins.description: Workflow automation for software engineering: publish (GitHub PR), review, feedback, address, debug, Jira/GitHub/Datadog auto-detection

plugins.name: homebrew
plugins.description: CI-gated GitHub release workflow for Homebrew-distributed projects - SemVer version selection, release notes, optional GoReleaser, tag publishing, release verification

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Task-board work framework for hobby/solo repos: groom, work, batch-work, acceptance-verifier gate, decision log, cross-repo status, framework-init scaffolding, framework-doctor validation/cleanup. Tasks are files in workflow/<status>/ folders (folder = status), board view via ./workflow/status, repo specifics in a workflow/AGENTS.md contract

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Delegate self-contained tasks to Codex (GPT-5.6) subagents - codex-delegate.sh wrapper returns only the final message with a resumable session id and optional contract-marker check, codex-runner agent for native-subagent dispatch, model/effort routing guidance (luna/terra/sol)
